metric: raw unsmoothed evaluation nearest 5M; no interpolation or time weighting; group means weight seeds equally
scope: fixed 3s attached and 6h detached development sets; 6h selected using prior BACM performance; no population failure-rate inference; whole-framework comparison, not gate-only ablation
reader: TensorBoard EventAccumulator; all simple scalar tags loaded with size_guidance scalars=0; Sacred cross-check; no independent audit of TensorBoard internal CRC checks
summary_field_scope: last/last_five/max_win_rate cover the complete log, including some historical 10M BM runs; use near_5m or last_five_within_5_05m for matched-budget comparisons
